description: ROUND's scaling (T-3658): kept-digit integers m whose nearest double m*10^-n differs from the binary product m*(10^-n), at num_digits n = 1..12, with inputs m.3, m.4, m.49.., m.5.. and the longest 15-digit m.499..9 below the half, exact m, a negated case, and ROUNDDOWN controls. Sheet Hits: the 61 decimals m*10^-n (m < 20000, n <= 15) whose nearest double differs from the double reached by rounding to a 64-bit significand first, read as ROUND results (A, B, H-J), literals (C, K), quotients (D), VALUE (E) and a stored number (G = F). Separates 'nearest double' from 'multiply by 10^-n' (eval/accuracy/tables/ROUND/s1 A61).
